lines.en: label undeservedfuture15:
scene whathappensinpink1
: Shi-chan! Hi. Status report, please. How goes the hunt for my half-sister? Or whatever it is I’m supposed to call her if she wasn’t actually created by my dad.
lines.zh: : Shi 酱！你好。请汇报状况。找我同父异母的姐姐——或者如果她其实不是我爸造的，我该叫她什么来着——进展如何？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink2
: You know, you should really get a DNA test. I know you’re suspicious too and that’s one of the few answers I’m of virtually no help with.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你们真该去做个 DNA 检测。我知道你也起疑了，而这几乎是我唯一帮不上忙的问题。

lines.en: : {i}The status report is that I’m going to need you to cover my next three shifts to make up for what I’m going through right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}状况汇报就是，我接下来三个班都得你替我顶，才能弥补我现在经历的一切。{/i}

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink3
: That tough to find, huh?
lines.zh: : 那么难找吗？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink4
: No, I found her alright. I was just unaware of how much of a mess she was going to make.
lines.zh: : 不，我找到她了。只是没想到她会搞出这么大一个烂摊子。

lines.en: : {i}Oh, you did?! But, wait. A mess as in-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，你真的找到了？！可是，等等。烂摊子是指——{/i}

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink5
: As in the same thing you called me to clean up at the dorms. Just this time, I have to tend to a flower garden as well. So thanks for that. I hate flowers.
lines.zh: : 就是指你叫我去宿舍收拾的那种东西。只是这次我还得打理一个花园。所以谢了。我讨厌花。

lines.en: : {i}But I’m a flower and you love me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我就是花啊，而且你爱我。{/i}

lines.en: : Five shifts now. I’m serious, Himawari. This is a much bigger job than I expected.
lines.zh: : 现在五个班了。我是认真的，Himawari。这活儿比我预想的要大得多。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink6
: Thankfully, there were five grouped up here at Tsukioka Manor. Seems like your “half-sister” had a post-apocalyptic craving for arts and crafts and decided to saw some rich girls into pieces.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，Tsukioka Manor 那儿有五个聚在一起。看来你那位「同父异母的姐姐」在世界末日后突然对手工产生了兴趣，决定把几个有钱人家的女孩锯成块。

lines.en: : Think she caught on that we were here, though. Hung herself from a tree before I even arrived and two of the girls still have all of their parts attached. Left a note too.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得她察觉到我们在这儿了。我到之前她就上吊挂在树上了，而且还有两个女孩的零件是齐全的。还留了张纸条。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink7
: Also, she can’t {i}fly,{/i} can she?
lines.zh: : 还有，她不会{i}飞{/i}吧？

lines.en: : {i}What? Obviously not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么？当然不会。{/i}

lines.en: : Guess she’s just very good at climbing trees then. I’m going to need to go back for a ladder or I won’t be able to get her down.
lines.zh: : 那看来她只是很擅长爬树。我得回去拿把梯子，不然没法把她弄下来。

lines.en: : I need some more boxes anyway, though, so I guess it’s not that big of a deal.
lines.zh: : 反正我也需要更多箱子，所以这也不算什么大事。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink3
: Who does that leave then? If there are five, does that mean Nodoka’s there? Or are some of dad’s older friends still unaccounted for?
lines.zh: : 那还剩谁？如果有五个，是不是说明 Nodoka 在那儿？还是说爸爸那些年长的朋友里还有没找到的？

lines.en: : {i}I think that’s everyone. Plus one extra since there were two of that Fukuyama girl for some reason.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得人都齐了。还多出一个，因为不知道为什么有两个那个 Fukuyama 女孩。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, that happens here sometimes. Think there’s some sort of glitch causing certain girls to replicate during the pause.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这种事在这儿有时候会发生。我猜是某种故障，导致某些女孩在暂停期间会复制。

lines.en: : Dad said she was acting strangely earlier, so that might have something to do with why she-
lines.zh: : 爸爸说她之前表现得挺奇怪的，说不定跟她——

lines.en: : {i}I don’t care. This place sucks and I don’t want to help with it anymore. Just let this world collapse and smuggle your parents back to your dream world so you can all disappear together.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不关心。这地方烂透了，我不想再管了。就让这个世界崩塌吧，然后把你爸妈偷渡回你的梦里世界，你们全一起消失算了。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m really sorry, Shi-chan. I just didn’t have anybody else to ask for help. All the other reps who are already familiar with this terminal have it out for me.
lines.zh: : 真的很对不起，Shi 酱。我只是没有别人可以求助了。其他已经熟悉这个终端的专员都跟我过不去。

lines.en: : {i}I wonder if that has anything to do with how you’re constantly shaking their ant farm.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我猜这跟你老是去晃他们的蚂蚁工坊有关系吧？{/i}

lines.en: : That probably has something to do with it, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概确实有点关系，嗯。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink8
: To be honest, I’m surprised this one has lasted this long in the first place. I’d have condemned it from the get-go if I was the one in charge.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我挺惊讶这个世界居然能撑这么久。要是换我管，一开始就把它判死了。

lines.en: : {i}You say that about every world you visit.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你每到一个世界都这么说。{/i}

lines.en: : Sure, but no one from any of those worlds has known about {i}us.{/i} If this Ami girl were to escape somehow and took that information with her, she’d be putting everything at risk.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但那些世界里没人知道{i}我们{/i}的存在。如果那个 Ami 女孩想办法逃出去、还把那些信息带走了，她会把一切都置于险地。

lines.en: : {i}I know. I completely agree. But nothing has worked so far so, like...what can we even do about it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我知道。我完全同意。但目前什么办法都没用，所以……我们到底还能怎么办？{/i}

lines.en: : File an F4972-B. We need to bring in a Peerless One if nothing we do is working. She’s too big of a risk.
lines.zh: : 提交一份 F4972-B。既然我们怎么做都没用，就得请一位「无双者」来处理。她的风险太大了。

lines.en: : {i}None of them will touch her. Those forms always come back rejected.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他们没人会碰她。那种表格每次都被打回来。{/i}

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink9
: {i}Rejected?{/i} No, that can’t be right.
lines.zh: : {i}打回来？{/i}不，不可能。

lines.en: : {i}It is, though. I can show you the next time we go to the office.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是真的。下次我们去办公室的时候我可以给你看。{/i}

lines.en: : Himawari, the only time those forms are rejected is if the party in question is already under the protection of a god. And Ami doesn’t have a contract with anyone. At least not a legal one.
lines.zh: : Himawari，那种表格只有在当事人已经受到某位神的庇护时才会被驳回。而 Ami 没有跟任何神签约。至少没有合法的。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink8
: Can’t be a snake oil deal either. They register their clients even faster than {i}we{/i} do so they don’t keep getting solicited and pressured into better partnerships.
lines.zh: : 也不可能是狗皮膏药交易。他们登记客户比{i}我们{/i}还快，好让自己不再被反复推销、被逼着签更好的合作。

lines.en: : {i}You’re the expert here, Shiori-Senpai. I don’t know most of that official stuff yet. I just know what I’ve seen.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是这方面的专家，Shiori 前辈。那些官方的东西我还大多不懂。我只知道我亲眼见到的。{/i}

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink10
: Ugh...god damn it. Now I’m curious and I {i}have{/i} to look into it. I can’t believe you roped me into this bullshit.
lines.zh: : 呃……该死。现在我被勾起好奇心了，{i}非得{/i}查一查。我真不敢相信你把我拖进了这摊狗屎。

lines.en: : Should have just given your dad a mop. Let him be scarred for all I care. I feel like an {i}actual{/i} janitor today with how much blood I’ve had to clean off of everything.
lines.zh: : 就该直接给你爸一把拖把。他留下心理阴影关我什么事。我今天擦了这么多血，感觉自己就是个{i}真正的{/i}清洁工。

lines.en: : {i}Again, I’m sorry. You were my last hope and I’ll do whatever I can to make it up to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再次说声抱歉。你是我最后的希望，我会尽我所能补偿你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But if that’s everything and there’s no one left to be found, is it okay if I-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过如果这就是全部、也没人还需要找了，我能不能——{/i}

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink8
: Yeah. Go enjoy your final hours in whatever the hell this place is called. I’ll file the report once I finish up with these bodies.
lines.zh: : 行。去享受你们在这个鬼地方的余下时间吧。我处理完这些身体就提交报告。

lines.en: : You can’t come back though, Himawari. Doing this through me is only going to make the target on your back bigger once the documents are reviewed.
lines.zh: : 不过你不能回来了，Himawari。通过我来办这件事，只会让你背上更大的靶子，等文件被审查的时候。

lines.en: : And what’s even better is that {i}I’ll{/i} have one on {i}my{/i} back now too. So that’s fun. I love being watched.
lines.zh: : 更妙的是，现在{i}我{/i}背上也有一个了。真有意思。我最喜欢被盯着了。

lines.en: : {i}Shi-chan-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Shi 酱——{/i}

lines.en: : For the last time, stop calling me that or I will report you myself.
lines.zh: : 最后一次，别这么叫我，不然我亲自举报你。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink11
scene whathappensinpink12
: That girl’s going to wind up like you one day, mysterious dead teenager who is hopefully named Nodoka. Just with much less fanfare and little to no artistic value.
lines.zh: : 那姑娘有一天会变得跟你一样——某个神秘死去的少女，希望她叫 Nodoka。只是排场小得多，也没什么艺术价值。

lines.en: scene black
: Now, let’s work on your memories.
lines.zh: : 好了，现在来处理你的记忆。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink13
: Assuming that Ami girl didn’t do anything to your face, that is. I’ve done enough reconstruction for one day. I hope you’re easy.
lines.zh: : 前提是那个 Ami 女孩没对你的脸做什么。今天我已经做够了重建工作。我希望你省事点。

lines.en: : Anyway, let’s see what I’m working with this time.
lines.zh: : 总之，让我看看这次要面对什么。

lines.en: scene black
scene whathappensinpink14
scene whathappensinpink15
scene black
: Kyoko?...
lines.zh: : Kyoko？……

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink16
: Great news, guys! Every cast member has now been accounted for and we are free to enjoy the rest of our time together like the world is {i}not{/i} currently engrossed in a weird intermission!
lines.zh: : 好消息，各位！所有演员现在都到齐了，我们可以自由地享受剩下的时光了，就像这个世界此刻{i}没有{/i}陷入一场诡异的幕间休息一样！

lines.en: : I take it your friend found Ami then? How was she? Was she still...sentient? Like you thought she’d be?
lines.zh: : 我猜你朋友找到 Ami 了？她怎么样？她还……有意识吗？像你预想的那样？

lines.en: : Out like a light, so no questions this time. Same way Sana was. Shiori-Senpai’s taking care of her memory stuff now.
lines.zh: : 彻底昏死过去了，所以这次问不出什么。跟 Sana 一样。Shiori 前辈正在处理她的记忆。

lines.en: : How...{i}was{/i} Sana exactly? I still don’t really understand what’s happening here...
lines.zh: : Sana 到底……{i}是{/i}什么样的？我还是不太明白这儿在发生什么……

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink17
: Just limp and lifeless basically, but not {i}actually{/i} dead. Himawari says she’ll go back to normal once the world starts back up.
lines.zh: : 基本上就是瘫软、毫无生气，但并不是{i}真的{/i}死了。Himawari 说等世界重新运转起来她就会恢复正常。

lines.en: : People kind of just plop over once the “apocalypse” happens. Then I go around touching them until everyone is fixed. The end. That’s the condensed version of my job.
lines.zh: : 一旦「末日」发生，人们就会直接倒下。然后我就到处摸她们，直到所有人都被修好。结束。这就是我工作的浓缩版。

lines.en: : I wish I could have seen you in action. But I also think that might make me sad since I did ultimately resign myself to you being an unemployed, stay-at-home daughter forever.
lines.zh: : 我真希望能看到你工作的样子。不过我觉得那可能会让我难过，因为我最终还是认定了你就是个永远失业、蹲在家里的女儿。

lines.en: : Well, thats great news too! Because I really only took this job in the first place to try and make things better for you guys.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也是个好消息！因为我最开始接这份工作，就是为了让你们的日子好过一点。

lines.en: : I’m quitting as soon as I can get you out of here and starting up my own company instead. One that’ll {i}really{/i} make the world a better place.
lines.zh: : 等我一把你们弄出去，我就辞职，自己开公司。一家{i}真正{/i}能让世界变得更好的公司。

lines.en: : Are things not...{i}good{/i} for us in...whatever your main world is then?
lines.zh: : 那……在……你的主世界里，我们过得不{i}好{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Sorry. That’s classified.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。那是机密。

lines.en: : Is this company you’re apparently going to start up classified as well?
lines.zh: : 你打算开的这家公司也是机密吗？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink18
: Depends. Are you going to use the information I give you to start up your {i}own{/i} competing company before I am born and send my fate spiraling into an infinite pit of purposelessness?
lines.zh: : 取决于你。你会不会拿我给你的情报，在我出生之前就开一家跟我竞争的公司，把我的人生命运卷进一个毫无意义的无底洞？

lines.en: : Do I look like the type of person who’d be able to run his own business, Himawari?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像是那种能自己经营生意的人吗，Himawari？

lines.en: : You bastard. You’re already calling it {i}your{/i} business when you know for a fact that it’s my idea. Hope you’re ready for a hefty lawsuit, buddy.
lines.zh: : 你这个混蛋。你明知道这是我的点子，就已经开始叫它「{i}你的{/i}生意」了。准备好接一份巨额诉讼吧，老兄。

lines.en: : Can you tell {i}me,{/i} Hima-chan? If I promise not to compete against you?
lines.zh: : 那你能告诉{i}我{/i}吗，Hima 酱？如果我保证不跟你竞争？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink19
: I don’t mind telling either of you guys, really. Or {i}anyone{/i} for that matter. Because it’s less about the money and more about the {i}possibility{/i} to me.
lines.zh: : 其实我不介意告诉你们俩。或者告诉{i}任何人{/i}。因为对我来说，这跟钱关系不大，更多是关于{i}可能性{/i}。

lines.en: : If someone wants to do it first, that’s fine. But it’s something I want, so it’s something I will {i}make{/i} if I really have to.
lines.zh: : 如果有人想先做出来，那也没关系。但这是我想要的东西，所以如果非做不可，我就会把它{i}做出来{/i}。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink20
: The idea is simple — what if {i}everyone{/i} got to have a happy ending?
lines.zh: : 想法很简单——如果{i}每个人{/i}都能有个幸福的结局呢？

lines.en: : And what if there was some brilliant, blue-eyed angel out there who came up with a system in which that dream could become a reality?
lines.zh: : 如果外面有个聪明绝顶的蓝眼睛天使，想出了一套能让那个梦想成真的系统呢？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink21
: What if those worlds we wished for and perfect outcomes weren’t just temporary reprieves from collapsing timelines, but {i}destinations{/i} one could visit any time they want to?
lines.zh: : 如果我们许愿得来的那些世界、那些完美的结局，不只是崩塌时间线里的暂缓之所，而是人们随时可以造访的{i}目的地{/i}呢？

lines.en: : Whether it be for a day, a week, or the rest of your life — the vision I have is one where everyone can do what I do. {i}Go{/i} places I can and see all there is to see.
lines.zh: : 不管是一天、一周，还是你的余生——我的愿景是，每个人都能做我现在做的事。{i}去{/i}我能去的地方，看尽所有能看的。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink22

: {size=-2}The world we have now is unfair. The whole system is unfair — where wishes are granted for a you that isn’t {i}you{/i} while a you who {i}isn’t{/i} you gets to reap the benefits of it without doing any of the legwork.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我们现在的世界是不公平的。整个系统都不公平——愿望被许给了一个不是你的{i}你{/i}，而另一个{i}不是{/i}你的你却可以不费一点力气就坐享其成。{/size}

lines.en: : So I want to change that. I don’t want people to be stuck somewhere they aren’t happy. I want them to be {i}free.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以我想改变这个。我不想人们被困在他们不快乐的地方。我想要他们{i}自由{/i}。

lines.en: : And if they’re to be free, they shouldn’t be boxed in by worlds with walls on every side just because that’s where they woke up one day. You know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 而如果他们要自由，就不该被四面都是墙的世界困住，只因为他们某天醒来时就在那儿。你懂我的意思吗？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我懂。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to just open a boba shop instead, though? That sounds way easier and way more plausible.
lines.zh: : 不过你确定你不想干脆开家奶茶店吗？那听起来简单多了，也靠谱多了。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink23
: Oh, yeah. I guess boba makes people happy too. That {i}does{/i} sound easier.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。奶茶也能让人幸福嘛。听起来{i}确实{/i}简单些。

lines.en: : So Hima-chan finally has a dream and you immediately shoot it down? Not even going to pretend it doesn’t sound completely insane?
lines.zh: : 所以 Hima 酱终于有了梦想，你立刻就把它否定了？连装都懒得装一下、说它听起来没那么疯狂？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink24

: {size=-2}You think I don’t know it’s insane? Simply {i}pitching{/i} that to somebody could earn me the ire of some spiteful god. Plus, I’m learning firsthand right now just how hard it {i}is{/i} to do what I want to do.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}你觉得我不知道这很疯狂吗？光是把它{i}推销{/i}给别人，就可能招来某个记仇的神的怒火。更别提我现在正亲身体验做我想做的事有多难。{/size}

lines.en: : You guys are basically my first customers as an intergalactic tour guide. And I don’t think I need to tell you I’m doing a pretty terrible job after the Aomori fiasco.
lines.zh: : 你们基本上就是我作为星际导游的第一批客户。我想用不着我多说——在 Aomori 那场闹剧之后，我干得有多糟糕。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink25
: But I’m going to get better. And I might not be a god myself, but I don’t think they’re much stronger than humans in the grand scheme of things since we all feed off of each other.
lines.zh: : 但我会变好的。而且我自己也许不是神，但我觉得从大局来看，他们并不比人类强多少，因为我们互相依存。

lines.en: : That said, who’s to say that anything really {i}is{/i} impossible? Who’s to say that {i}I{/i} can’t sculpt the universe myself when I’ve already made {i}one?{/i}
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，谁说任何事真的{i}是{/i}不可能的？谁说{i}我自己{/i}塑造不了宇宙——毕竟我已经造过{i}一个{/i}了？

lines.en: : {i}How{/i} though? Because if your weird, divine megacorp can’t manage to keep everything under control with both humans {i}and{/i} gods on their side, how do {i}you{/i} expect to?
lines.zh: : 可{i}怎么{/i}做？因为如果你那家奇怪的神圣巨企，在人{i}和{/i}神都站在他们那边的情况下都没法把一切管住，{i}你{/i}凭什么觉得自己能？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink26
: No clue. That boba idea is really starting to sound a lot more enticing, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 不知道。说真的，那个奶茶的点子现在听起来诱人多了。

lines.en: : Who’s stealing whose idea now?
lines.zh: : 现在是谁在偷谁的点子？

lines.en: : Oh, you slick son of a mother.
lines.zh: : 哦，你这个滑头的家伙。

lines.en: : Hima-chan, can I say something?
lines.zh: : Hima 酱，我能说两句吗？

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink27
: Don’t ask {i}me{/i} for permission. You’re my mom. Even if you’re the same age and only an inch or two taller right now.
lines.zh: : 别问{i}我{/i}准不准。你是我妈。哪怕你现在跟我同岁、只比我高一两英寸。

lines.en: : I just want to say that if anyone {i}can{/i} make something like that happen, it’s you. You’ve already accomplished so much.
lines.zh: : 我只想说，如果有谁{i}能{/i}做到那样的事，那就是你。你已经做到了这么多。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink28
: Well, thank you...but, I really haven’t.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢……不过，我真的没有。

lines.en: : Everything I’ve done so far has only made things worse. And if you guys can’t figure the rest out on your own, I...
lines.zh: : 我到目前为止做的一切都只让事情变得更糟。而如果你们自己没法搞定剩下的，我……

lines.en: : Everything will have been for nothing.
lines.zh: : 一切就都白费了。

lines.en: : No it won’t, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 不会的，Himawari。

lines.en: scene whathappensinpink29
: I mean it, though. If this world really {i}does{/i} end-
lines.zh: : 我说真的。如果这个世界{i}真的{/i}终结了——

lines.en: : I don’t care what you mean. You’ve showed me that there’s {i}more{/i} to life. That I {i}can{/i} be happy. And that’s not something I’ve ever really believed before.
lines.zh: : 我不管你是什么意思。你让我看到了人生还有{i}别的{/i}可能。我也{i}可以{/i}幸福。而这是我以前从未真正相信过的。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: I don’t know if it will happen in this world. Or whatever one I wind up in if we {i}do{/i} get out of here.
lines.zh: : 我不知道它会不会发生在这个世界。或者如果我们{i}真{/i}能逃出去，会发生在哪一个世界。

lines.en: : But it {i}will{/i} happen somewhere. And I can take solace in just knowing that I’m doing better off somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 但它{i}总会{/i}发生在某个地方。光是知道自己在别处会过得更好，我就能得到慰藉。

lines.en: : And that one day, I will be the most average father to the most amazing daughter who has ever lived.
lines.zh: : 而且总有一天，我会成为史上最了不起的女儿的那个最平凡的父亲。

lines.en: : You’ll have all the free boba you could ever imagine too. Promise.
lines.zh: : 你也会拥有想象不到的、喝不完的免费奶茶。我保证。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}I hate that I cried for so long. I missed out on so much.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我恨自己哭了那么久。我错过了太多。

lines.en: : Hima-chan, how much time do we have left? When do you need to leave?
lines.zh: : Hima 酱，我们还剩多少时间？你什么时候得走？

lines.en: : Soon, but...
lines.zh: : 很快，不过……

lines.en: scene black
: If it’s okay...
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话……

lines.en: : I have an idea of where we can go next.
lines.zh: : 我想到了下一个可以去的地方。
